quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: True or false: Use high beam headlights when driving in fog.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect off the fog and back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: What should you do if you see this sign above your lane?

options.text: You can stay in your lane or exit the freeway.
You must stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane leaves the highway. You can change lanes to continue on the highway, or you must exit if you stay in this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community group is cleaning up trash ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that workers may be on or very close to the road. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What should you do if your accelerator gets stuck while driving?

options.text: Reach down and try to pull it up.
Shift to neutral and press the brake steadily.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to neutral and press the brake steadily.
questions.explanation: Keep your eyes on the road. Shift into neutral quickly and press the brake steadily. Pull off the road safely and turn off the engine.

questions.question: Roads freeze most quickly when they are:
questions.explanation: Shaded areas under trees or buildings freeze faster than sunny areas and are the last places to thaw. Drive carefully on these sections in cold or wet weather.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: When you see a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line with the broken line next to your lane, when may you pass?
questions.explanation: When the broken yellow line is on your side, you may pass if there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a flagger is controlling traffic ahead in a construction area.

questions.question: ____ greatly increase stopping distances and crash severity.
questions.explanation: High speeds increase stopping distances and crash severity. The faster you drive, the harder your vehicle hits in a collision.

questions.question: Vertical driver licenses are issued to persons:
questions.explanation: In Virginia, licenses and ID cards for people under 21 are vertical.

questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, you should first:

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull up even with the car in front of your desired parking space.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up even with the car in front of your desired parking space.
questions.explanation: Stop parallel to the car in front of your parking space. Check traffic and signal. Then turn your wheels to park.

questions.question: After being pulled over by law enforcement, a driver should immediately exit the vehicle and quickly approach the officer's squad car.
questions.explanation: Stay in your vehicle with both hands visible on the steering wheel when stopped by law enforcement.

questions.question: It is unlawful to drive alongside a motorcycle in the same lane.
questions.explanation: Never share a lane with a motorcycle. Motorcyclists need the full lane width to maneuver safely.

questions.question: It is important to slow down:

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp curves, near pedestrians, and on wet or slippery roads.

questions.question: You are driving in the right lane of a multilane highway and want to move into the left lane. You should:

options.text: Look in your rearview mirror for traffic behind you before changing lanes.
Look over your left shoulder for traffic in your blind spot before changing lanes.
Look in your side mirror for traffic and turn on your directional signal.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look over your shoulder for your blind spot. Always signal when changing lanes.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: When may you proceed through an intersection that has a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to verify that there is no cross traffic
After coming to a complete stop and verifying that it is safe to proceed
After you have stopped at least 20 feet prior to the intersection
After slowing down to a speed of 10 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and verifying that it is safe to proceed
questions.explanation: Come to a complete stop before entering the intersection. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before the intersection and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When passing other vehicles:

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
Honk your horn at least three times.
Re-enter your lane within 10 feet of the passed vehicle.
There is no need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors and blind spots before passing. Signal before changing lanes. Re-enter your lane when you can see the front of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: When backing up, what should you do?

options.text: Open your door to check if it is safe.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: Always look behind your vehicle before backing up. Children and small objects are hard to see from the driver's seat. Turn your head to see through the rear window while backing. Do not rely only on mirrors or sensors.

questions.question: What is defensive driving?

options.text: Spotting dangerous situations and taking action to avoid accidents.
Passing slow drivers by getting ahead of them in traffic.
Following the vehicle in front of you closely.
Changing lanes quickly and weaving through traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spotting dangerous situations and taking action to avoid accidents.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means you notice dangerous situations and act before an accident happens. It helps you avoid problems with reckless, careless, or impaired drivers and pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let others go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you reach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle approaches with its siren and/or flashing lights, you must immediately:

options.text: Move to the right and stop.
Move to the right and slow down.
Move to the right and turn on your four-way flashers.
Stop and let the emergency vehicle pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle approaches with lights, sirens, or other warnings, you must immediately move to the right side of the road and stop.

questions.question: How can stress affect your driving?

options.text: It lowers your ability to focus on driving.
It decreases your chances of an accident.
It causes you to fall asleep at the wheel.
It makes you more aware of others around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: It lowers your ability to focus on driving.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions affect your driving ability. If you are worried, upset, afraid, angry, or sad, you may not drive well. Stress reduces your concentration on driving. Wait to drive if you are emotionally upset.

questions.question: What is a blind spot?

options.text: An area you cannot see without turning your head.
The area directly behind your vehicle.
An area you see in your rearview mirror.
An area you see in your side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: An area you cannot see without turning your head.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see without moving your head. They are usually to the sides and behind your vehicle.

questions.question: You must use your headlights when you use your windshield wipers because of bad weather.
questions.explanation: You must use your headlights whenever you use your windshield wipers because of bad weather.

questions.question: On slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Drive at the speed limit with caution.

questions.explanation: Slow down when rain, snow, or ice makes roads slippery. Poor road conditions may require you to drive slower than the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The safest top speed under good road and weather conditions.
The safest top speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest top speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit for safety. Always slow down when conditions are poor.

questions.question: If you drive in fog, what should you do?

options.text: Turn on your low beam headlights.
It is okay to drive at the maximum speed limit.
Do not drive faster than 10 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: You must use headlights when you cannot see 500 feet ahead. Use low beams in fog or rain. High beams reflect light back at you and make it harder to see.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.
Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light works the same as:
questions.explanation: At a flashing red light, you must stop and let all other traffic pass before you go.

questions.question: Is nighttime the safest time for cyclists to ride?
questions.explanation: Bikes are hard to see at night, even with lights and reflectors. Drivers and cyclists must stay alert at night to avoid crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What happens when a driver is distracted?

options.text: The driver reacts slower to hazards.
It is only dangerous for young drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver reacts slower to hazards.
questions.explanation: Distractions slow down how fast a driver can respond to traffic and dangers. Distracted driving is never safe.
